label: TCR loci / LMO2

sections.text: TCR loci encode T-cell receptor chains and contain lineage-active regulatory elements.
LMO2 encodes a LIM-domain scaffold for hematopoietic transcriptional complexes.

T-cell-receptor regulatory rearrangements can activate LMO2 expression in developing T cells, disrupting normal lineage-specific transcription. This is an enhancer-driven oncogenic mechanism in T-ALL rather than an asserted chimeric TCR protein.
